name: windows-timezone-set
title: Set the time zone
description: Sets the Windows time zone (Set-TimeZone). The default is Mountain Standard Time (Colorado sites); give another Windows zone id for a remote user. The previous zone is kept so it can be undone.
measure: if ($auto -and "$($auto.StartType)" -ne 'Disabled') { Add-ArhWarning 'Set time zone automatically is on: Windows may change the zone back' }
if (-not (Get-TimeZone -ListAvailable | Where-Object { $_.Id -eq $id })) { Add-ArhBlocker "Unknown Windows time zone id: $id" }
if ($cur.Id -eq $id) { Set-ArhPlan $false "Already $id" } else { Set-ArhPlan $true "Change the time zone from $($cur.Id) to $id" }
